thread:
Anya: Heads-up — onboarding Kestrel-7B (community variant). Int4 quant smoke shows repeated emoji collapse in summarization tests. Repro: prompt with emoji sequences + ZWJ yields collapsed tokens / repeated replacement tokens.

Raj: Oof, that sounds like a proj-order/byte-layout mismatch. Did you compare fp16 vs int4 logits around the embed proj?

Anya: Yeah, fp16 baseline is fine. Int4 topk diverges after ~12 tokens on a short summary test. Example snippet: `input: "Release notes 🎉‍♂️ — summary please"` -> output has `�` repeats.

Sophia: Could be rotary headwise scaling interacting with projection order. Kestrel uses permuted proj layout (kvqk style) unlike our usual gemma/llama mapping. We saw similar when head concat/order differed.

Raj: Quick check: dump first-layer proj weight shape and raw bytes, compare endianness/projorder. I ran `xxd -g 4 model/emb_proj.bin | head` before — different chunking can blow reconstruction in int4.

Noah: Also check tokenization: emoji clusters with ZWJ can produce multi-codepoint tokens. If tokenizer merges them differently between converters, token IDs shift and rotary phase indexing may be off.

Anya: Good call. I compared token ids for the problematic input between Kestrel tokenizer and our standard tokenizer: they differ by an offset of 2 for the combined emoji cluster.

Sophia: That offset would shift the rotary phase by 2 positions -> misaligned rotation -> catastrophic interference when KV cache uses tokenid-indexed phase.

Anya: Re-ran with forced tokenmap remap (added a small shim) and the int4 outputs matched fp16 again. So it's interaction of tokenmap + proj-order + rotary indexing under quantization noise.

triage-bot: Suggested action: open a conversion-handoff with steps to normalize proj-order and emit a tokenmap remap for ZWJ clusters. Tagging eng-ml. :white_check_mark:

Raj: For next steps I suggest: 1) run a repro harness across 1k emoji-heavy prompts; 2) add a conversion check that validates embedding-proj ordering (canonical compare); 3) add a small unit test that ensures tokenizer cluster IDs are stable post-conversion.

Noah: I'll spin up a bisect job to try the conversion pipeline changes: swap proj-order permutation -> quantize -> smoke. ETA ~1.5h. Posting logs to #eng-ml when done.

Anya: Thanks — if bisect narrows to converter version, we'll push a hotfix for private customers using Kestrel import. I'll post the failure traces and the minimal repro once bisect finishes. :pray:
